titleEn: Minimum Cost of a Path With Special Roads
title: 前往目标的最小代价
summary: 平面上可按曼哈顿距离付费任意移动，并可使用若干从指定起点到终点的有向特殊道路，求 start 到 target 的最小代价。
insight: 真正改变普通步行几何结构的只有特殊道路终点。把 start 和每条道路终点作为 Dijkstra 状态；从当前点可步行到任一道路起点再支付道路费用到其终点，也可直接步行到 target。正权保证 Dijkstra 首次确定最小代价。
pitfalls: 道路之间可通过普通步行衔接
直接步行到目标始终是候选
代价中间值用 long 更稳妥

solutions.title: 特殊道路终点上的 Dijkstra
solutions.idea: 只把使用特殊道路后的落点加入最短路状态。
steps: distance[i] 表示到第 i 条道路终点的最小代价
最小堆先放 start、代价零
弹出当前坐标与代价，用 cost+曼哈顿距离到 target 更新答案
对每条道路计算 cost+走到 road.start+road.cost
若改善该道路终点距离则入堆

code.java: class Solution { private long manhattan(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2){return Math.abs((long)x1-x2)+Math.abs((long)y1-y2);}public int minimumCost(int[] start,int[] target,int[][] specialRoads){int roads=specialRoads.length;long[] distance=new long[roads];Arrays.fill(distance,Long.MAX_VALUE);PriorityQueue<long[]> queue=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(state->state[0]));queue.add(new long[]{0,start[0],start[1],-1});long answer=manhattan(start[0],start[1],target[0],target[1]);while(!queue.isEmpty()){long[] state=queue.poll();long cost=state[0];int x=(int)state[1],y=(int)state[2],index=(int)state[3];if(index>=0&&cost!=distance[index])continue;answer=Math.min(answer,cost+manhattan(x,y,target[0],target[1]));for(int i=0;i<roads;i++){int[] road=specialRoads[i];long next=cost+manhattan(x,y,road[0],road[1])+road[4];if(next<distance[i]){distance[i]=next;queue.add(new long[]{next,road[2],road[3],i});}}}return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun manhattan(x1:Int,y1:Int,x2:Int,y2:Int)=kotlin.math.abs(x1.toLong()-x2)+kotlin.math.abs(y1.toLong()-y2);fun minimumCost(start:IntArray,target:IntArray,specialRoads:Array<IntArray>):Int{val distance=LongArray(specialRoads.size){Long.MAX_VALUE};val queue=java.util.PriorityQueue<LongArray>(compareBy<LongArray>{it[0]});queue.add(longArrayOf(0,start[0].toLong(),start[1].toLong(),-1));var answer=manhattan(start[0],start[1],target[0],target[1]);while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.poll();val cost=state[0];val x=state[1].toInt();val y=state[2].toInt();val index=state[3].toInt();if(index>=0&&cost!=distance[index])continue;answer=minOf(answer,cost+manhattan(x,y,target[0],target[1]));for(i in specialRoads.indices){val road=specialRoads[i];val next=cost+manhattan(x,y,road[0],road[1])+road[4];if(next<distance[i]){distance[i]=next;queue.add(longArrayOf(next,road[2].toLong(),road[3].toLong(),i.toLong()))}}};return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long manhattan(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2){return abs((long long)x1-x2)+abs((long long)y1-y2);}public:int minimumCost(vector<int>& start,vector<int>& target,vector<vector<int>>& specialRoads){int roads=specialRoads.size();vector<long long> distance(roads,LLONG_MAX);using State=array<long long,4>;priority_queue<State,vector<State>,greater<State>> queue;queue.push({0,start[0],start[1],-1});long long answer=manhattan(start[0],start[1],target[0],target[1]);while(!queue.empty()){auto [cost,xValue,yValue,indexValue]=queue.top();queue.pop();int x=xValue,y=yValue,index=indexValue;if(index>=0&&cost!=distance[index])continue;answer=min(answer,cost+manhattan(x,y,target[0],target[1]));for(int i=0;i<roads;++i){auto& road=specialRoads[i];long long next=cost+manhattan(x,y,road[0],road[1])+road[4];if(next<distance[i]){distance[i]=next;queue.push({next,road[2],road[3],i});}}}return answer;} };
